verses.textZh: 保罗、西拉和提摩太，写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在我们的父神和主耶稣基督里的教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗、西拉和提摩太，写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在我们的父神和主耶稣基督里的教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗、西拉、提摩太写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在神－我们的父与主耶稣基督里的教会。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, Silas, and Timothy. We are writing to the church in Thessalonica, to you who belong to God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.textEn: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安从父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安从父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安从父神和主耶稣基督归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我们应该常常为你们感谢神，这是合适的。因为你们的信心格外长进，你们众人彼此相爱的心也在增加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我们应该常常为你们感谢神，这是合适的。因为你们的信心格外长进，你们众人彼此相爱的心也在增加。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们该为你们常常感谢神，这本是合宜的；因你们的信心格外增长，并且你们众人彼此相爱的心也都充足。
verses.textEnNiv: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, and rightly so, because your faith is growing more and more, and the love all of you have for one another is increasing.
verses.textEnEsv: We ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers, as is right, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing.
verses.textEnNkjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is fitting, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of every one of you all abounds toward each other,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, we can’t help but thank God for you, because your faith is flourishing and your love for one another is growing.
verses.textEnNasb: We ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters, as is only fitting, because your faith is increasing abundantly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another grows ever greater.
verses.textEn: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, and rightly so, because your faith is growing more and more, and the love all of you have for one another is increasing.

verses.textZh: 所以我们在神的众教会里，亲自夸奖你们，因为你们在所受的一切迫害患难中，仍然存着坚忍和信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们在神的众教会里，亲自夸奖你们，因为你们在所受的一切迫害患难中，仍然存着坚忍和信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至我们在神的各教会里为你们夸口，都因你们在所受的一切逼迫患难中，仍旧存忍耐和信心。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, among God’s churches we boast about your perseverance and faith in all the persecutions and trials you are enduring.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore we ourselves boast about you in the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions that you are enduring.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that we ourselves boast of you among the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that you endure,
verses.textEnNlt: We proudly tell God’s other churches about your endurance and faithfulness in all the persecutions and hardships you are suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: As a result, we ourselves speak proudly of you among the churches of God for your perseverance and faith in the midst of all your persecutions and afflictions which you endure.
verses.textEn: Therefore, among God’s churches we boast about your perseverance and faith in all the persecutions and trials you are enduring.

verses.textZh: 这正是神公义判断的明证，使你们可以算是配得上他的国；你们也是为了神的国而受苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这正是神公义判断的明证，使你们可以算是配得上他的国；你们也是为了神的国而受苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 这正是神公义判断的明证，叫你们可算配得神的国；你们就是为这国受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: All this is evidence that God’s judgment is right, and as a result you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
verses.textEnEsv: This is evidence of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering—
verses.textEnNkjv: whichis manifest evidence of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you also suffer;
verses.textEnNlt: And God will use this persecution to show his justice and to make you worthy of his Kingdom, for which you are suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: This is a plain indication of God’s righteous judgment so that you will be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you indeed are suffering.
verses.textEn: All this is evidence that God’s judgment is right, and as a result you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

verses.textZh: 又要报应那些不认识神、不听从我们主耶稣的福音的人。910当主来的时候，他们要受永远沉沦的惩罚，就是离开主的面和他权能的荣光。在那一天，他要在圣徒身上得着荣耀，又要在所有信徒身上受到尊崇 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要报应那些不认识神、不听从我们主耶稣的福音的人。910当主来的时候，他们要受永远沉沦的惩罚，就是离开主的面和他权能的荣光。在那一天，他要在圣徒身上得着荣耀，又要在所有信徒身上受到尊崇 。
verses.textZhCuv: 神既是公义的，就必将患难报应那加患难给你们的人，
verses.textEnNiv: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you
verses.textEnEsv: since indeed God considers it just to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
verses.textEnNkjv: since itis a righteous thing with God to repay with tribulation those who trouble you,
verses.textEnNlt: In his justice he will pay back those who persecute you.
verses.textEnNasb: For after all it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
verses.textEn: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you

verses.textZh: 因此，我们常常为你们祷告，愿我们的神看你们是配得上所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们所羡慕的一切良善和信心的工作，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们常常为你们祷告，愿我们的神看你们是配得上所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们所羡慕的一切良善和信心的工作，
verses.textZhCuv: 也必使你们这受患难的人与我们同得平安。那时，主耶稣同他有能力的天使从天上在火焰中显现，
verses.textEnNiv: and give relief to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.
verses.textEnEsv: and to grant relief to you who are afflicted as well as to us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels
verses.textEnNkjv: and to give you who are troubled rest with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels,
verses.textEnNlt: And God will provide rest for you who are being persecuted and also for us when the Lord Jesus appears from heaven. He will come with his mighty angels,
verses.textEnNasb: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus will be revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
verses.textEn: and give relief to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.

verses.textZh: 使我们主耶稣的名，照着我们的神和主耶稣基督的恩，在你们身上得着荣耀，你们也在他身上得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我们主耶稣的名，照着我们的神和主耶稣基督的恩，在你们身上得着荣耀，你们也在他身上得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 要报应那不认识神和那不听从我主耶稣福音的人。
verses.textEnNiv: He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: in flaming fire taking vengeance on those who do not know God, and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: in flaming fire, bringing judgment on those who don’t know God and on those who refuse to obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: in flaming fire, dealing out retribution to those who do not know God, and to those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEn: He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们要受刑罚，就是永远沉沦，离开主的面和他权能的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要受刑罚，就是永远沉沦，离开主的面和他权能的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要受刑罚，就是永远沉沦，离开主的面和他权能的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might
verses.textEnEsv: They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
verses.textEnNkjv: These shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,
verses.textEnNlt: They will be punished with eternal destruction, forever separated from the Lord and from his glorious power.
verses.textEnNasb: These people will pay the penalty of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,
verses.textEn: They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might

verses.textZh: 这正是主降临、要在他圣徒的身上得荣耀、又在一切信的人身上显为希奇的那日子。我们对你们作的见证，你们也信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这正是主降临、要在他圣徒的身上得荣耀、又在一切信的人身上显为希奇的那日子。我们对你们作的见证，你们也信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这正是主降临、要在他圣徒的身上得荣耀、又在一切信的人身上显为希奇的那日子。我们对你们作的见证，你们也信了。
verses.textEnNiv: on the day he comes to be glorified in his holy people and to be marveled at among all those who have believed. This includes you, because you believed our testimony to you.
verses.textEnEsv: when he comes on that day to be glorified in his saints, and to be marveled at among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
verses.textEnNkjv: when He comes, in that Day, to be glorified in His saints and to be admired among all those who believe, because our testimony among you was believed.
verses.textEnNlt: When he comes on that day, he will receive glory from his holy people—praise from all who believe. And this includes you, for you believed what we told you about him.
verses.textEnNasb: when He comes to be glorified among His saints on that day, and to be marveled at among all who have believed—because our testimony to you was believed.
verses.textEn: on the day he comes to be glorified in his holy people and to be marveled at among all those who have believed. This includes you, because you believed our testimony to you.

verses.textZh: 因此，我们常为你们祷告，愿我们的神看你们配得过所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们一切所羡慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们常为你们祷告，愿我们的神看你们配得过所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们一切所羡慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我们常为你们祷告，愿我们的神看你们配得过所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们一切所羡慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，
verses.textEnNiv: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.
verses.textEnEsv: To this end we always pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling and may fulfill every resolve for good and every work of faith by his power,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we also pray always for you that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfill all the good pleasure of His goodness and the work of faith with power,
verses.textEnNlt: So we keep on praying for you, asking our God to enable you to live a life worthy of his call. May he give you the power to accomplish all the good things your faith prompts you to do.
verses.textEnNasb: To this end also we pray for you always, that our God will consider you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire for goodness and the work of faith with power,
verses.textEn: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.

verses.textZh: 叫我们主耶稣的名在你们身上得荣耀，你们也在他身上得荣耀，都照着我们的神并主耶稣基督的恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫我们主耶稣的名在你们身上得荣耀，你们也在他身上得荣耀，都照着我们的神并主耶稣基督的恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫我们主耶稣的名在你们身上得荣耀，你们也在他身上得荣耀，都照着我们的神并主耶稣基督的恩。
verses.textEnNiv: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the name of our Lord Jesus will be honored because of the way you live, and you will be honored along with him. This is all made possible because of the grace of our God and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, in accordance with the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，关于我们主耶稣基督的再来，和我们到他那里聚集的事，我们求你们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，关于我们主耶稣基督的再来，和我们到他那里聚集的事，我们求你们：
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，论到我们主耶稣基督降临和我们到他那里聚集，
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to him, we ask you, brothers,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, brethren, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him, we ask you,
verses.textEnNlt: Now, dear brothers and sisters, let us clarify some things about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and how we will be gathered to meet him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, regarding the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him,
verses.textEn: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,

verses.textZh: 无论有灵、有话、有冒我们的名的书信，说主的日子现在到了，你们都不要轻易动心，也不要惊慌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论有灵、有话、有冒我们的名的书信，说主的日子现在到了，你们都不要轻易动心，也不要惊慌。
verses.textZhCuv: 我劝你们：无论有灵、有言语、有冒我名的书信，说主的日子现在 到了，不要轻易动心，也不要惊慌。
verses.textEnNiv: not to become easily unsettled or alarmed by the teaching allegedly from us—whether by a prophecy or by word of mouth or by letter—asserting that the day of the Lord has already come.
verses.textEnEsv: not to be quickly shaken in mind or alarmed, either by a spirit or a spoken word, or a letter seeming to be from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.
verses.textEnNkjv: not to be soon shaken in mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter, as if from us, as though the day of Christ had come.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be so easily shaken or alarmed by those who say that the day of the Lord has already begun. Don’t believe them, even if they claim to have had a spiritual vision, a revelation, or a letter supposedly from us.
verses.textEnNasb: that you not be quickly shaken from your composure or be disturbed either by a spirit, or a message, or a letter as if from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.
verses.textEn: not to become easily unsettled or alarmed by the teaching allegedly from us—whether by a prophecy or by word of mouth or by letter—asserting that the day of the Lord has already come.

verses.textZh: 不要让人用任何方法迷惑了你们，因为主的日子来到以前，必定有背道的事，并且那不法的人，就是那沉沦之子，必定显露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要让人用任何方法迷惑了你们，因为主的日子来到以前，必定有背道的事，并且那不法的人，就是那沉沦之子，必定显露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 人不拘用什么法子，你们总不要被他诱惑；因为那日子以前，必有离道反教的事，并有那大罪人，就是沉沦之子，显露出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t let anyone deceive you in any way, for that day will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the man doomed to destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one deceive you by any means; for thatDaywillnotcome unless the falling away comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of perdition,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be fooled by what they say. For that day will not come until there is a great rebellion against God and the man of lawlessness is revealed—the one who brings destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: No one is to deceive you in any way! For it will not come unless the apostasy comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,
verses.textEn: Don’t let anyone deceive you in any way, for that day will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the man doomed to destruction.

verses.textZh: 他抵挡神，抬举自己，高过一切称为神或受人敬拜的，甚至坐在神的殿中，自称为神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他抵挡神，抬举自己，高过一切称为神或受人敬拜的，甚至坐在神的殿中，自称为神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是抵挡主，高抬自己，超过一切称为神的和一切受人敬拜的，甚至坐在神的殿里，自称是神。
verses.textEnNiv: He will oppose and will exalt himself over everything that is called God or is worshiped, so that he sets himself up in God’s temple, proclaiming himself to be God.
verses.textEnEsv: who opposes and exalts himself against every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
verses.textEnNkjv: who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God.
verses.textEnNlt: He will exalt himself and defy everything that people call god and every object of worship. He will even sit in the temple of God, claiming that he himself is God.
verses.textEnNasb: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, displaying himself as being God.
verses.textEn: He will oppose and will exalt himself over everything that is called God or is worshiped, so that he sets himself up in God’s temple, proclaiming himself to be God.

verses.textZh: 我还在你们那里的时候，曾经把这些事告诉你们，你们不记得吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还在你们那里的时候，曾经把这些事告诉你们，你们不记得吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我还在你们那里的时候，曾把这些事告诉你们，你们不记得吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not remember that when I was still with you I told you these things?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not remember that when I was still with you I told you these things?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you remember that I told you about all this when I was with you?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not remember that while I was still with you, I was telling you these things?
verses.textEn: Don’t you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?

verses.textZh: 现在你们也知道，那箝制他，使他到了时候才可以显露出来的是甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们也知道，那箝制他，使他到了时候才可以显露出来的是甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们也知道，那拦阻他的是什么，是叫他到了的时候才可以显露。
verses.textEnNiv: And now you know what is holding him back, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
verses.textEnEsv: And you know what is restraining him now so that he may be revealed in his time.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now you know what is restraining, that he may be revealed in his own time.
verses.textEnNlt: And you know what is holding him back, for he can be revealed only when his time comes.
verses.textEnNasb: And you know what restrains him now, so that he will be revealed in his time.
verses.textEn: And now you know what is holding him back, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

verses.textZh: 因为那不法的潜力已经发动，只是现在有一个箝制他的在那里，直等到那箝制解除了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那不法的潜力已经发动，只是现在有一个箝制他的在那里，直等到那箝制解除了，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那不法的隐意已经发动，只是现在有一个拦阻的，等到那拦阻的被除去，
verses.textEnNiv: For the secret power of lawlessness is already at work; but the one who now holds it back will continue to do so till he is taken out of the way.
verses.textEnEsv: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work. Only he who now restrains it will do so until he is out of the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only He who now restrains willdoso until He is taken out of the way.
verses.textEnNlt: For this lawlessness is already at work secretly, and it will remain secret until the one who is holding it back steps out of the way.
verses.textEnNasb: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only He who now restrains will do so until He is removed.
verses.textEn: For the secret power of lawlessness is already at work; but the one who now holds it back will continue to do so till he is taken out of the way.

verses.textZh: 那时，这不法的人必要显露出来。主耶稣要用自己口中的气除掉他，以自己再来所显现的光辉消灭他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，这不法的人必要显露出来。主耶稣要用自己口中的气除掉他，以自己再来所显现的光辉消灭他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时这不法的人必显露出来。主耶稣要用口中的气灭绝他，用降临的荣光废掉他。
verses.textEnNiv: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will overthrow with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the splendor of his coming.
verses.textEnEsv: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will consume with the breath of His mouth and destroy with the brightness of His coming.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man of lawlessness will be revealed, but the Lord Jesus will slay him with the breath of his mouth and destroy him by the splendor of his coming.
verses.textEnNasb: Then that lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will eliminate with the breath of His mouth and bring to an end by the appearance of His coming;
verses.textEn: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will overthrow with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the splendor of his coming.

verses.textZh: 这不法的人来到，是照着撒但的行动，行各样的异能奇迹和荒诞的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不法的人来到，是照着撒但的行动，行各样的异能奇迹和荒诞的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 这不法的人来，是照撒但的运动，行各样的异能、神迹，和一切虚假的奇事，
verses.textEnNiv: The coming of the lawless one will be in accordance with how Satan works. He will use all sorts of displays of power through signs and wonders that serve the lie,
verses.textEnEsv: The coming of the lawless one is by the activity of Satan with all power and false signs and wonders,
verses.textEnNkjv: The coming of the lawlessone is according to the working of Satan, with all power, signs, and lying wonders,
verses.textEnNlt: This man will come to do the work of Satan with counterfeit power and signs and miracles.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, the one whose coming is in accord with the activity of Satan, with all power and false signs and wonders,
verses.textEn: The coming of the lawless one will be in accordance with how Satan works. He will use all sorts of displays of power through signs and wonders that serve the lie,

verses.textZh: 并且在那些沉沦的人身上，行各样不义的欺诈，因为他们不领受爱真理的心，使他们得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且在那些沉沦的人身上，行各样不义的欺诈，因为他们不领受爱真理的心，使他们得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且在那沉沦的人身上行各样出于不义的诡诈；因他们不领受爱真理的心，使他们得救。
verses.textEnNiv: and all the ways that wickedness deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: and with all wicked deception for those who are perishing, because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: and with all unrighteous deception among those who perish, because they did not receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: He will use every kind of evil deception to fool those on their way to destruction, because they refuse to love and accept the truth that would save them.
verses.textEnNasb: and with all the deception of wickedness for those who perish, because they did not accept the love of the truth so as to be saved.
verses.textEn: and all the ways that wickedness deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.

verses.textZh: 因此，神就使错谬的思想运行在他们当中，让他们相信虚谎，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，神就使错谬的思想运行在他们当中，让他们相信虚谎，
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，神就给他们一个生发错误的心，叫他们信从虚谎，
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore God sends them a strong delusion, so that they may believe what is false,
verses.textEnNkjv: And for this reason God will send them strong delusion, that they should believe the lie,
verses.textEnNlt: So God will cause them to be greatly deceived, and they will believe these lies.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason God will send upon them a deluding influence so that they will believe what is false,
verses.textEn: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie

verses.textZh: 叫所有不信真理倒喜爱不义的人，都被定罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫所有不信真理倒喜爱不义的人，都被定罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 使一切不信真理、倒喜爱不义的人都被定罪。
verses.textEnNiv: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: in order that all may be condemned who did not believe the truth but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they all may be condemned who did not believe the truth but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will be condemned for enjoying evil rather than believing the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: in order that they all may be judged who did not believe the truth, but took pleasure in wickedness.
verses.textEn: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.

verses.textZh: 主所爱的弟兄们，我们应该常常为你们感谢神，因为他从起初就拣选了你们，借着圣灵成圣的工作，和你们对真道的信心，使你们可以得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主所爱的弟兄们，我们应该常常为你们感谢神，因为他从起初就拣选了你们，借着圣灵成圣的工作，和你们对真道的信心，使你们可以得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 主所爱的弟兄们哪，我们本该常为你们感谢神；因为他从起初拣选了你们，叫你们因信真道，又被圣灵感动，成为圣洁，能以得救。
verses.textEnNiv: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit and through belief in the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: But we ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers beloved by the Lord, because God chose you as the firstfruits to be saved, through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved by the Lord, because God from the beginning chose you for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth,
verses.textEnNlt: As for us, we can’t help but thank God for you, dear brothers and sisters loved by the Lord. We are always thankful that God chose you to be among the first to experience salvation—a salvation that came through the Spirit who makes you holy and through your belief in the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: But we should always give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters beloved by the Lord, because God has chosen you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and faith in the truth.
verses.textEn: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit and through belief in the truth.

verses.textZh: 因此，神借着我们所传的福音呼召你们，使你们得着我们主耶稣基督的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，神借着我们所传的福音呼召你们，使你们得着我们主耶稣基督的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 神藉我们所传的福音召你们到这地步，好得着我们主耶稣基督的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: He called you to this through our gospel, that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: To this he called you through our gospel, so that you may obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: to which He called you by our gospel, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: He called you to salvation when we told you the Good News; now you can share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: It was for this He called you through our gospel, that you may obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: He called you to this through our gospel, that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄们，你们要站立得稳；你们所领受的教训，无论是我们口传的，或是信上写的，都要持守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄们，你们要站立得稳；你们所领受的教训，无论是我们口传的，或是信上写的，都要持守。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，弟兄们，你们要站立得稳，凡所领受的教训，不拘是我们口传的，是信上写的，都要坚守。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.
verses.textEnEsv: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold to the traditions that you were taught by us, either by our spoken word or by our letter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, brethren, stand fast and hold the traditions which you were taught, whether by word or our epistle.
verses.textEnNlt: With all these things in mind, dear brothers and sisters, stand firm and keep a strong grip on the teaching we passed on to you both in person and by letter.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold on to the traditions which you were taught, whether by word of mouth or by letter from us.
verses.textEn: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

verses.textZh: 愿我们的主耶稣基督自己，和那爱我们、开恩把永远的安慰和美好的盼望赐给我们的父神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我们的主耶稣基督自己，和那爱我们、开恩把永远的安慰和美好的盼望赐给我们的父神，
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿我们主耶稣基督和那爱我们、开恩将永远的安慰并美好的盼望赐给我们的父神，
verses.textEnNiv: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,
verses.textEnEsv: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and our God and Father, who has loved us and given us everlasting consolation and good hope by grace,
verses.textEnNlt: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope,
verses.textEnNasb: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope by grace,
verses.textEn: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,

verses.textZh: 安慰你们的心，并且在一切善行善言上，坚定你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 安慰你们的心，并且在一切善行善言上，坚定你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 安慰你们的心，并且在一切善行善言上坚固你们。
verses.textEnNiv: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.
verses.textEnEsv: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.
verses.textEnNkjv: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good word and work.
verses.textEnNlt: comfort you and strengthen you in every good thing you do and say.
verses.textEnNasb: comfort and strengthen your hearts in every good work and word.
verses.textEn: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

verses.textZh: 最后，弟兄们，请为我们祷告，好叫主的道也像在你们那里一样快快传开，得着荣耀，
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后，弟兄们，请为我们祷告，好叫主的道也像在你们那里一样快快传开，得着荣耀，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我还有话说：请你们为我们祷告，好叫主的道理快快行开，得着荣耀，正如在你们中间一样，
verses.textEnNiv: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the message of the Lord may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may speed ahead and be honored, as happened among you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run swiftly and be glorified, just as itis with you,
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, dear brothers and sisters, we ask you to pray for us. Pray that the Lord’s message will spread rapidly and be honored wherever it goes, just as when it came to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the word of the Lord will spread rapidly and be glorified, just as it was also with you;
verses.textEn: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the message of the Lord may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was with you.

verses.textZh: 也使我们能够脱离那些不讲理的恶人，因为不是人人都有信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也使我们能够脱离那些不讲理的恶人，因为不是人人都有信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 也叫我们脱离无理之恶人的手；因为人不都是有信心。
verses.textEnNiv: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, for not everyone has faith.
verses.textEnEsv: and that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men. For not all have faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men; for not all have faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Pray, too, that we will be rescued from wicked and evil people, for not everyone is a believer.
verses.textEnNasb: and that we will be rescued from troublesome and evil people; for not all have the faith.
verses.textEn: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, for not everyone has faith.

verses.textZh: 主是信实的，他必坚定你们，保护你们脱离那恶者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主是信实的，他必坚定你们，保护你们脱离那恶者。
verses.textZhCuv: 但主是信实的，要坚固你们，保护你们脱离那恶者 。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord is faithful. He will establish you and guard you against the evil one.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen and protect you from the evil one.
verses.textEn: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

verses.textZh: 我们靠着主深深相信，你们现在以及将来都会遵行我们所吩咐的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们靠着主深深相信，你们现在以及将来都会遵行我们所吩咐的，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们靠主深信，你们现在是遵行我们所吩咐的，后来也必要遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: We have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we command.
verses.textEnEsv: And we have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things that we command.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you, both that you do and will do the things we command you.
verses.textEnNlt: And we are confident in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we commanded you.
verses.textEnNasb: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you are doing, and will do, what we command.
verses.textEn: We have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we command.

verses.textZh: 愿主引导你们的心，使你们有神的爱和基督的坚忍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主引导你们的心，使你们有神的爱和基督的坚忍。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主引导你们的心，叫你们爱神，并学基督的忍耐！
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord direct your hearts to the love of God and to the steadfastness of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the patience of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord lead your hearts into a full understanding and expression of the love of God and the patient endurance that comes from Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord direct your hearts to the love of God and to the perseverance of Christ.
verses.textEn: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我们奉主耶稣基督的名吩咐你们，凡是游手好闲的弟兄，不按着你们从我们所领受的教训去行，就应当远离他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我们奉主耶稣基督的名吩咐你们，凡是游手好闲的弟兄，不按着你们从我们所领受的教训去行，就应当远离他。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们奉主耶稣基督的名吩咐你们，凡有弟兄不按规矩而行，不遵守从我们所受的教训，就当远离他。
verses.textEnNiv: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, we command you, brothers and sisters, to keep away from every believer who is idle and disruptive and does not live according to the teaching you received from us.
verses.textEnEsv: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from any brother who is walking in idleness and not in accord with the tradition that you received from us.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw from every brother who walks disorderly and not according to the tradition which he received from us.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, dear brothers and sisters, we give you this command in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ: Stay away from all believers who live idle lives and don’t follow the tradition they received from us.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother or sister who leads a disorderly life and not one in accordance with the tradition which you received from us.
verses.textEn: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, we command you, brothers and sisters, to keep away from every believer who is idle and disruptive and does not live according to the teaching you received from us.

verses.textZh: 你们自己本来就知道应当怎样效法我们，因为我们在你们中间并没有游手好闲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们自己本来就知道应当怎样效法我们，因为我们在你们中间并没有游手好闲，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们自己原知道应当怎样效法我们。因为我们在你们中间，未尝不按规矩而行，
verses.textEnNiv: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,
verses.textEnEsv: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not idle when we were with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow us, for we were not disorderly among you;
verses.textEnNlt: For you know that you ought to imitate us. We were not idle when we were with you.
verses.textEnNasb: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example, because we did not act in an undisciplined way among you,
verses.textEn: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,

verses.textZh: 也没有白吃过谁的饭，反而辛苦劳碌，昼夜作工，免得加重你们任何一人的负担。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也没有白吃过谁的饭，反而辛苦劳碌，昼夜作工，免得加重你们任何一人的负担。
verses.textZhCuv: 也未尝白吃人的饭，倒是辛苦劳碌，昼夜做工，免得叫你们一人受累。
verses.textEnNiv: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. On the contrary, we worked night and day, laboring and toiling so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
verses.textEnEsv: nor did we eat anyone’s bread without paying for it, but with toil and labor we worked night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor did we eat anyone’s bread free of charge, but worked with labor and toil night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you,
verses.textEnNlt: We never accepted food from anyone without paying for it. We worked hard day and night so we would not be a burden to any of you.
verses.textEnNasb: nor did we eat anyone’s bread without paying for it, but with labor and hardship we kept working night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you;
verses.textEn: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. On the contrary, we worked night and day, laboring and toiling so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

verses.textZh: 这不是因为我们没有权利，而是要给你们作榜样，好让你们效法我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不是因为我们没有权利，而是要给你们作榜样，好让你们效法我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这并不是因我们没有权柄，乃是要给你们作榜样，叫你们效法我们。
verses.textEnNiv: We did this, not because we do not have the right to such help, but in order to offer ourselves as a model for you to imitate.
verses.textEnEsv: It was not because we do not have that right, but to give you in ourselves an example to imitate.
verses.textEnNkjv: not because we do not have authority, but to make ourselves an example of how you should follow us.
verses.textEnNlt: We certainly had the right to ask you to feed us, but we wanted to give you an example to follow.
verses.textEnNasb: not because we do not have the right to this, but in order to offer ourselves as a role model for you, so that you would follow our example.
verses.textEn: We did this, not because we do not have the right to such help, but in order to offer ourselves as a model for you to imitate.

verses.textZh: 我们在你们那里的时候，曾经吩咐过你们，如果有人不肯作工，就不可吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在你们那里的时候，曾经吩咐过你们，如果有人不肯作工，就不可吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在你们那里的时候，曾吩咐你们说，若有人不肯做工，就不可吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: For even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: "The one who is unwilling to work shall not eat."
verses.textEnEsv: For even when we were with you, we would give you this command: If anyone is not willing to work, let him not eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: If anyone will not work, neither shall he eat.
verses.textEnNlt: Even while we were with you, we gave you this command: "Those unwilling to work will not get to eat."
verses.textEnNasb: For even when we were with you, we used to give you this order: if anyone is not willing to work, then he is not to eat, either.
verses.textEn: For even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: "The one who is unwilling to work shall not eat."

verses.textZh: 因为我们听说，你们中间有人游手好闲，甚么工也不作，反倒专管闲事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们听说，你们中间有人游手好闲，甚么工也不作，反倒专管闲事。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我们听说，在你们中间有人不按规矩而行，什么工都不做，反倒专管闲事。
verses.textEnNiv: We hear that some among you are idle and disruptive. They are not busy; they are busybodies.
verses.textEnEsv: For we hear that some among you walk in idleness, not busy at work, but busybodies.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we hear that there are some who walk among you in a disorderly manner, not working at all, but are busybodies.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet we hear that some of you are living idle lives, refusing to work and meddling in other people’s business.
verses.textEnNasb: For we hear that some among you are leading an undisciplined life, doing no work at all, but acting like busybodies.
verses.textEn: We hear that some among you are idle and disruptive. They are not busy; they are busybodies.

verses.textZh: 我们靠着主耶稣基督，吩咐劝戒这样的人，要安静作工，自食其力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们靠着主耶稣基督，吩咐劝戒这样的人，要安静作工，自食其力。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们靠主耶稣基督吩咐、劝戒这样的人，要安静做工，吃自己的饭。
verses.textEnNiv: Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and earn the food they eat.
verses.textEnEsv: Now such persons we command and encourage in the Lord Jesus Christ to do their work quietly and to earn their own living.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who are such we command and exhort through our Lord Jesus Christ that they work in quietness and eat their own bread.
verses.textEnNlt: We command such people and urge them in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and work to earn their own living.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we command and exhort such persons in the Lord Jesus Christ to work peacefully and eat their own bread.
verses.textEn: Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and earn the food they eat.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们行善不可灰心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们行善不可灰心。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们行善不可丧志。
verses.textEnNiv: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.
verses.textEnEsv: As for you, brothers, do not grow weary in doing good.
verses.textEnNkjv: But asfor you, brethren, do not grow weary in doing good.
verses.textEnNlt: As for the rest of you, dear brothers and sisters, never get tired of doing good.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, brothers and sisters, do not grow weary of doing good.
verses.textEn: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.

verses.textZh: 如果有人不听从我们这封信上的训勉，要把这个人记下来，不可和他来往，好叫他自己觉得惭愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人不听从我们这封信上的训勉，要把这个人记下来，不可和他来往，好叫他自己觉得惭愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人不听从我们这信上的话，要记下他，不和他交往，叫他自觉羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Take special note of anyone who does not obey our instruction in this letter. Do not associate with them, in order that they may feel ashamed.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone does not obey what we say in this letter, take note of that person, and have nothing to do with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone does not obey our word in this epistle, note that person and do not keep company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: Take note of those who refuse to obey what we say in this letter. Stay away from them so they will be ashamed.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone does not obey our instruction in this letter, take special note of that person so as not to associate with him, so that he will be put to shame.
verses.textEn: Take special note of anyone who does not obey our instruction in this letter. Do not associate with them, in order that they may feel ashamed.

verses.textZh: 但不要把他看作仇敌，却要劝他好象劝弟兄一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但不要把他看作仇敌，却要劝他好象劝弟兄一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但不要以他为仇人，要劝他如弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet do not count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t think of them as enemies, but warn them as you would a brother or sister.
verses.textEnNasb: And yet do not regard that person as an enemy, but admonish that one as a brother or sister.
verses.textEn: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.

verses.textZh: 愿赐平安的主亲自随时随地赐平安给你们。愿主与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿赐平安的主亲自随时随地赐平安给你们。愿主与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿赐平安的主随时随事亲自给你们平安！愿主常与你们众人同在！
verses.textEnNiv: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
verses.textEnEsv: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in every way. The Lord be with you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace always in every way. The Lord be with you all.
verses.textEnNlt: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you his peace at all times and in every situation. The Lord be with you all.
verses.textEnNasb: Now may the Lord of peace Himself continually grant you peace in every circumstance. The Lord be with you all!
verses.textEn: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

verses.textZh: 我保罗亲笔问候你们。这是我每一封信的记号；我的笔迹就是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我保罗亲笔问候你们。这是我每一封信的记号；我的笔迹就是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－保罗亲笔问你们安。凡我的信都以此为记，我的笔迹就是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.
verses.textEnEsv: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. This is the sign of genuineness in every letter of mine; it is the way I write.
verses.textEnNkjv: The salutation of Paul with my own hand, which is a sign in every epistle; so I write.
verses.textEnNlt: Here is my greeting in my own handwriting—Paul. I do this in all my letters to prove they are from me.
verses.textEnNasb: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, and this is a distinguishing mark in every letter; this is the way I write.
verses.textEn: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.

verses.textZh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩常与你们众人同在！
verses.textEnNiv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
verses.textEnEsv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
verses.textEnNasb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
verses.textEn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
